title: (Senior) Data Platform Engineer (m/w/d)
description_clean:
Standort
To strengthen our Tech Team at Berlin, Constance or Munich, we are at earliest opportunity looking for a (Senior) Data Platform Engineer (m/w/d).
Deine Aufgaben

You own the technical platform through which wetter.com delivers weather & climate data products to B2B & B2C customers
You develop and operate innovative products together with our backend team, data scientists, or product owners (e.g. public and private APIs, webhooks, ML training & prediction pipelines, AI pipelines)

You have a degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, or an equivalent qualification
You have at least 2-3 years of experience in setting up and operating infrastructure and pipelines on AWS cloud
You have strong Python programming skills and hands-on experience with AWS Serverless
You are familiar with tools such as Spark, Terraform and Databricks
You have experience and/or strong interest in API design, developer experience (developer portal, webhooks) and shipping data-driven products to external customers – ideally with hands-on experience in Node.js/TypeScript
You already code and automate with AI, and you enjoy applying AI/LLM frameworks to build faster and smarter
You have excellent problem-solving skills with the ability to work both independently and as part of a team
You are motivated to take ownership, enjoy knowledge sharing and experimenting with new approaches

Deine Benefits

Ownership of your own projects, with the freedom to develop and implement your ideas and concepts
A corporate culture defined by team spirit, open communication, a dynamic atmosphere, flat hierarchies, and quick decision-making processes
Flexible hybrid working model, balancing home office and on-site presence
Informal and collaborative environment: no titles or strict dress codes, fostering a relaxed and approachable culture
A wide range of perks, social benefits, and employee services in a leading media company
Professional development and on-the-job training are key priorities for us

title: Strategic Account Executive Enterprise - DACH
description_clean:
🪐 Discover our galaxy
 
Join the Future of Work ! Malt is Europe's leading freelance marketplace, connecting over 1,000,000 talented freelancers with 100,000+ companies. Founded in 2013, we're transforming how work gets done through our tech-powered, human-centered platform. What makes us different:

A diverse team of 600 Malters across 6 European countries
A culture that champions equality (50% of our Comex are women) and inclusive growth
Backed by top investors including ISAI, Serena Capital, Eurazeo Growth, Goldman Sachs, and BPI
A mission to give everyone the freedom to work differently

Ready to help shape the future of work? Your next chapter starts here!
At Malt we believe that Ambition is the Way, so all lists of missions and responsibilities are non-exhaustive.The Mission 🪐
The Situation: Malt is cementing its position as the undeniable leader in the European freelance economy. While our tech-powered platform connects over 1,000,000 top-tier freelancers with 100,000+ companies, the Dutch Enterprise sector presents a massive, untapped frontier. This market is dominated by complex, multinational corporate structures with deeply entrenched procurement protocols that are ripe for disruption.
The Task: We are not hiring you to manage an existing portfolio or farm warm leads. You are being brought in to architect and own the zero-to-one enterprise acquisition strategy for the DACH region. Operating as the "founder" of your territory, your mandate is to systematically penetrate massive global accounts, navigate labyrinthine procurement structures, and secure highly scalable, multi-country Master Service Agreements (MSAs) that will cement Malt's dominance in the German-speaking market and beyond.
Key Responsibilities ✨
Pillar 1: Strategic Territory Architecture & Hunting

Action: Map out complex, global enterprise accounts within the DACH region, aggressively designing and executing surgical prospecting strategies to breach heavily fortified multi-stakeholder environments (Procurement, HR, and independent Business Units).
Output: A localized, highly qualified pipeline of net-new DACH Enterprise logos and concrete, multi-threaded stakeholder maps.
Metrics of Performance: Enterprise GSV Pipeline Generated and CRM forecast integrity.

Pillar 2: Deal Orchestration & RFP Command

Action: Run rigorous, in-depth discovery utilizing the full MEDDIC framework to validate severe business pain, identify the true Economic Buyer, and aggressively lead end-to-end RFI/RFP processes alongside our Bid Management and technical teams.
Output: Compelling, ROI-driven business proposals and precisely engineered enterprise pilot programs designed to prove undeniable platform value.
Metrics of Performance: RFI/RFP Win Rate and Pilot-to-MSA Conversion Rate.

Pillar 3: Heavy-Weight Negotiation & Scalable Revenue Activation

Action: Command ruthless, complex negotiations for global Master Service Agreements involving tight friction with Legal, Finance, and Procurement across multiple countries. Upon signature, engineer the scalable handover strategy to the local Account Management teams.
Output: Executed, multi-country MSAs and comprehensive post-signature deployment kickoff plans.
Metrics of Performance: Total Contract Value (TCV) Signed and Deal Velocity (managing complex cycles efficiently without losing momentum).

Requirements & The Skills Matrix 🔍Proven Mastery (What you have already built):

A minimum of 8 years of quantifiable, proven track record hunting and closing complex, 7-figure B2B sales cycles within a SaaS/Tech environment.
Deep familiarity with the staffing, "future of work" industry, MSPs, or Tier 1 recruitment groups.
Demonstrated success navigating extremely long sales cycles and managing strategic concessions to close highly scalable deals.
Native-level fluency in German and full professional fluency in English.

Skills You Will Deploy & Develop:

Advanced MEDDIC Mastery: You will deploy this framework with such rigor that you act as the internal benchmark and can actively coach others on its nuances.
C-Suite ROI Narrative Construction: Mastering the art of delivering disruptive narratives that challenge legacy customer assumptions and shift C-level perspectives on the "Future of Work."
Cross-Border Deal Structuring: Developing top-tier acumen in multi-country legal, financial, and compliance orchestration.
The Self-Selection Filter ❓
This role is perfect for you if:

You are an elite hunter who actively enjoys the strategic friction of a complex enterprise sales cycle and navigating massive corporate red tape.
You operate with extreme ownership—you treat your pipeline like your own startup's P&L and do not wait for permission or inbound leads to execute.
You naturally think in terms of "Economic Buyers," "Decision Criteria," and "Validation Events" rather than just "having good meetings."

This role is NOT for you if:

You rely heavily on inbound marketing or a pre-packaged SDR playbook to hit your pipeline numbers.
You get easily intimidated by heavy-weight legal negotiations, aggressive procurement teams, or highly structured RFP processes.
You prefer predictable, transactional account maintenance over the high-stakes thrill of net-new, multi-country enterprise acquisition.

30-60-90 Day Impact Plan 🏁
Day 30: Submerge into our marketplace mechanics, master the Malt value proposition, and map the top tier of DACH global enterprise accounts. Output: Delivery of your fully architected account penetration strategy.
Day 60: Execute initial outreach, identify key Economic Buyers within target accounts, and begin orchestrating your first high-stakes pilot phases. Output: Establish a predictable, MEDDIC-qualified enterprise pipeline.
Day 90: Take absolute control of your Metrics of Performance. Lead your first complex RFI/RFP processes or MSA negotiations end-to-end and initiate scalable handover plans. Output: Secure early enterprise traction that directly impacts the regional bottom line.
How to join the mission? 🚀

First Call (45m): High-level alignment with Niko (Talent Acquisition Lead) to audit your background and entrepreneurial drive.
Strategic Deep Dive (60m): Interview with your future manager, Théo, to dissect your past enterprise deals and MEDDIC rigor.
Business Case (60m): A live simulation to assess your technical account development, localized prospecting skills, and C-level narrative delivery.
Final Vision Call (30m): Interview with our CRO to discuss Malt’s long-term scale and how your ambition aligns with our macro-economic growth.

Life on planet Malt is the perfect space to thrive personally and professionally 💫
 
🤝 Onboarding: Before easing into your new role, you’ll spend your first week learning about our culture, products, and services with other onboardees at our office in Paris.
💻 Remote work: Hybrid remote policy - 3 days office / 2 days home-office.
🏖️ Annual leave: 30 days/year.
📆 Sabbatical: 1 month paid sabbatical once you've been with Malt for 3 years.
📈 Stock options: Every Malter is entitled to stock options. 
🍽️ Lunch vouchers: 6,50€ per day / 15 days a month.
🐶 Dog friendly office: In the heart of Munich/Berlin!
❓ Choose your Benefit: Transport reimbursement, Gym membership, Organic Food voucher or Rydes Mobility App.
📚 Free books: If you’re interested in learning more about any topic relevant to Malt’s business, just tell us the books you’d like to read, and we’ll order them for you—without any questions asked or approval processes to follow.

This role offers the opportunity to redefine quality assurance practices in an AI-driven technology environment.You will help build reliable, scalable products by combining advanced testing methodologies with AI-powered workflows.The position focuses on automation, quality strategy, and continuous improvement throughout the software development lifecycle.You will collaborate with engineering teams to embed quality from the earliest stages of development and delivery.By leveraging modern tools and innovative approaches, you will improve testing efficiency, product reliability, and team productivity.This is an ideal opportunity for a QA professional passionate about automation, AI adoption, and building high-quality software at scale.
Accountabilities:

Develop and maintain automated testing solutions that improve product quality and increase confidence throughout the development lifecycle.
Define and execute automation strategies based on product risks, scalability needs, and long-term quality objectives.
Analyze existing QA processes, identify improvement opportunities, and implement initiatives that enhance testing effectiveness.
Design comprehensive test coverage using advanced test analysis techniques across different testing layers, including unit, integration, and end-to-end testing.
Build, maintain, and improve automation frameworks and QA tools to ensure they remain reliable, scalable, and easy to use.
Use AI-powered tools daily to accelerate problem-solving, improve test design, enhance reporting, and increase engineering productivity.
Collaborate closely with engineers, product teams, and cross-functional stakeholders to integrate quality practices early in the development process.
Participate in code reviews, sprint planning, refinement sessions, and QA sign-off processes.
Take ownership of quality responsibilities within assigned product areas and drive continuous improvements.
Mentor team members, share QA expertise, and promote best practices across engineering teams.

Requirements:

3+ years of experience in QA automation with proven experience designing, implementing, and maintaining automated testing solutions.
Strong understanding of software testing methodologies, test planning, prioritization, documentation, and test design principles.
Hands-on experience with Playwright and familiarity with Selenium or similar automation frameworks.
Strong programming skills in TypeScript or another object-oriented programming language, with Python experience considered a plus.
Experience building and maintaining automation frameworks and improving QA processes within software development teams.
Ability to use AI tools effectively to improve productivity across test creation, automation, analysis, and reporting workflows.
Experience with REST API testing tools such as Postman, REST-assured, or Playwright API testing.
Understanding of different testing layers, including unit, integration, and end-to-end testing approaches.
Familiarity with QA tools such as Allure and TestRail.
Experience using Git and understanding of branching strategies and merge request workflows; knowledge of GitLab CI/CD is a plus.
Awareness of load and performance testing tools such as Locust or K6 is beneficial.
Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to prioritize tasks and take ownership from planning through completion.
Effective communication skills and ability to collaborate with cross-functional teams.
Advanced English proficiency, both written and spoken.

Benefits:

Remote-friendly work environment with flexibility to work from different locations.
Opportunity to join a globally distributed team collaborating across multiple countries and cultures.
Chance to contribute to the evolution of AI-powered products and modern quality engineering practices.
High-impact role with ownership over QA strategy, automation improvements, and engineering processes.
Opportunity to work in an innovative AI-focused organization where employees actively use AI tools to improve workflows.
Collaborative culture focused on ownership, continuous learning, and meaningful impact.
Professional growth opportunities through exposure to modern technologies, tools, and methodologies.
Inclusive workplace environment that values diverse perspectives and encourages employees to contribute their ideas.
Opportunity to help transform a fast-growing technology platform operating in a global market.

Sei es bei der Mitwirkung, bei der Umsetzung anspruchsvoller OZG-Verwaltungsleistungen nach dem Einer-für-Alle-Prinzip oder der Abschaffung aufwändiger Nachweispflichten für Bürger:innen und Unternehmen durch konsequente Umsetzung des Once Only-Prinzips durch die Registermodernisierung. Why Join Us
We're looking for passionate, talented people who want to be part of a winning team. At Partnerize, you'll find a culture of collaboration, innovation, and respect. We're looking for a Senior Platform Engineer to join our engineering team and champion the deployment architecture that drives our platform maturity. You'll be embedded within our engineering teams, optimizing day-to-day delivery across our on-premise estate while acting as the key engineering stakeholder to help shape, configure, and roll out our new Kubernetes platform, modernising how we deploy and scale workloads.
This is a hands-on role with real impact. You won't be rubber-stamping tickets; you'll have true autonomy over our CI/CD pipelines, automated guardrails, and migration strategies, shaping how engineering safely and rapidly ships value to production.
 
What You'll Be Doing
BAU & Platform Stability

Utilise and contribute to Ansible-based deployment automation to facilitate seamless product feature releases, adhering to established TechOps peer-review processes.
Monitor application-level health within the cluster, collaborating with TechOps on incident response and driving post-mortems for engineering-led deployments.
Maintain clear documentation, deployment runbooks, and developer self-service guides to streamline the engineering onboarding and release processes.

Kubernetes 

Represent Engineering as a key stakeholder in platform design: Collaborate with TechOps to shape engineering self-service workflows, guardrails, and standards. This includes contributing requirements for Kubernetes primitives (such as Gateway API, RBAC, admission controllers, and resource policies) to ensure engineering teams can move fast safely, without compromising core platform stability.
Standardise application-level configurations: Work alongside TechOps to establish clear engineering standards within the namespaces for ingress, RBAC, namespacing strategy, and secrets management.
Drive phased application migrations: Partner with engineering teams to containerise and migrate existing workloads to Kubernetes, starting with non-critical environments to establish confidence before moving business-critical systems.

Implement application observability: Set up application-level metrics, logging, and alerting within the namespaces, ensuring engineering teams have the visibility they need to monitor workload health.
Create developer self-service documentation: Document deployment runbooks, manifest templates, and best practices so that engineers can onboard and self-serve safely within the established guardrails.

 
What We're Looking For
Must-Have

Strong interpersonal and communication skills: we're a people-first culture where teamwork is paramount. On highly technical projects with many moving parts, the ability to collaborate openly, communicate clearly, and bring people with you is just as important as technical ability
Strong, demonstrable experience with Ansible: roles, inventories, vault, idempotency, the lot
Comfortable with Docker and Docker Compose in production environments
Understanding of networking fundamentals
Strong scripting ability: Bash and Python
Experience with GitOps tooling: ArgoCD or Flux
Experience with observability tooling (Prometheus, Grafana, Loki, Alertmanager or equivalent)
Ability to think creatively within constraints and plan pragmatically around them: our stack is real-world, not greenfield-perfect, and we need someone who can deliver iteratively, working with what exists today while roadmapping towards the ideal state
A methodical, security-conscious approach

Nice-to-Have

Familiarity with Helm chart authoring and management
Experience with infrastructure-as-code tools such as Terraform (even in an on-prem context)
Experience with secrets management tooling (HashiCorp Vault, Sealed Secrets, External Secrets Operator)
Prior experience in a role where you balanced greenfield work alongside BAU responsibilities

 
The Kind of Person We're After

You're comfortable being the person engineering teams come to when something's on fire, and you're also comfortable saying "let me schedule that properly" when it isn't
You can hold your own in a conversation with a software engineer, a network engineer, and senior leadership  even if they all want different things
You write things down. Runbooks and diagrams: you treat documentation as part of the job, not an afterthought
You have opinions about how things should be done, but you're pragmatic; you know when to pick the right tool vs. the perfect tool
Autonomously drive outcomes: we're looking for people who demonstrate intent and take initiative, not those who wait to be told what to do next

 
What We Offer

True ownership of the delivery lifecycle: The autonomy to shape how we ship code, build pipelines, and automate guardrails, moving entirely away from manual ticket execution.
A pivotal role in our cloud-native transformation: The opportunity to act as the key engineering stakeholder shaping our migration to Kubernetes, partnering closely with TechOps to build a modern, scalable platform.
 A progressive engineering culture: A collaborative, forward-thinking team that values automation, continuous improvement, and building modern delivery standards.

description_clean:

MultiBase is a Business Intelligence and Analytics consultancy with 35 years of experience guiding mid-sized companies in the DACH region to turn data into profit. MultiBase's 1,500+ projects. 400+ clients. Serving the DACH region since 1991. Our audience: CFOs and Heads of Controlling.
We are at an inflection point: shifting from traditional BI consulting to an AI-accelerated, IP-driven business built on our proprietary DECIDE framework. AI is not a tool here. It is an operational layer. Our founder creates the content and sets the strategy. Our AI agents write the copy. What is missing is the person who makes the whole machine run.
Tasks
The Role
You are the production and distribution engine of our marketing. Content direction and strategy come from the founder. Your job is to make that machine run at scale - and improve it as you go.
You report to the management. You will not be managed day-to-day, but you have a clear escalation path when a decision needs to be made. You interpret a brief correctly the first time, deliver without back-and-forth, and raise problems before anyone asks.
Concretely:

Own and run the marketing digital workforce: build, deploy, monitor, and improve AI agents and automated workflows across marketing and business development
Own the content calendar and the full publishing operation: YouTube uploads (titles, descriptions, tags, chapters, thumbnail briefings), LinkedIn scheduling, newsletter dispatch via our CRM. Zero missed publish dates
Build automations that remove manual steps from our workflows (agentic platforms, CRM automations, API integrations), so the human time required in marketing goes down, not up
Coordinate video production timelines with our editor and manage asset quality against the brief
Brief and steer an external paid-ads specialist: audience and ICP input, tracking setup (pixel, UTM), performance review against lead quality, not vanity metrics
Build and maintain an automated weekly performance report (YouTube, LinkedIn, newsletter, CRM) that management can read in 5 minutes
Produce and format supporting marketing assets: presentations, papers, website updates

Requirements
Who You Are

An executor, not a talker. Your value is that things ship, reliably, without anyone chasing you
Systematic by nature: you build checklists, SOPs, and processes because chaos offends you
AI-native: you work with AI agents as colleagues, not as occasional tools. You brief them, challenge their output, and push back when they are wrong
Self-correcting: when something breaks, you fix it fast and adjust the process so it does not break again
You care about outcomes (qualified leads, published assets, hours saved), not titles

Must-Have

AI-native, proven: daily, hands-on proficiency with at least one major agentic platform (n8n, Make, Claude Code / Cowork, OpenClaw, Hermes, or any comparable orchestration and automation platform). You have built and run agents and automated workflows, not just written prompts. This is the single most important requirement
2+ years in a B2B marketing environment (agency or in-house), in a small team where you owned outcomes end-to-end
Content operations experience: you have run a content calendar and multi-channel publishing workflow (video, social, email) for a real brand
Marketing automation: you build workflows yourself, without engineering support
Paid ads literacy: enough to brief a specialist, review campaign performance, and catch obvious errors in targeting and tracking. You do not need to be the specialist
Business-level English required. German at any level is a meaningful advantage for this role
Self-directed: you do not need daily management

Nice to Have (Not Required)

German: a strong plus for reviewing and quality-checking DACH content
GoHighLevel (GHL) CRM experience
Short-form video production (Reels, Shorts), thumbnail creation, basic editing
Experience using LLM APIs (Claude, GPT) for marketing automation
B2B content marketing experience for mid-market DACH companies

This Role Is Not For You If...

Your primary identity is "I'm a creative" or "I'm a strategist". Strategy and creative direction are owned by the founder
You use AI "sometimes" and cannot describe specific workflows you have built
You need a detailed brief and daily check-ins for every task
You cannot name concrete results from your previous marketing work
You have only worked in large marketing departments with clear lane separation
You accept AI output without questioning whether it is right

What Success Looks Like
After 3 months:

You own the content calendar completely: zero missed publish dates
Management spends zero time on content logistics: they create, the machine handles the rest
At least two automations are live that removed manual steps from the current workflow
At least one paid campaign is running with clean tracking and a clear performance report
The automated weekly marketing report exists and takes 5 minutes to read

After 6 months:

A consistent flow of warm, qualified leads comes from content and paid channels, without management having to run marketing operations
The marketing digital workforce is operational, documented, and measurably reducing manual work every month

Benefits
What You Get

Direct access to management: zero layers, zero bureaucracy
A real digital-workforce mandate: you build and own the marketing machine
Full AI tool budget
Remote-first, core hours 10:00-16:00 CET
Quarterly in-person team weeks in Paphos, Cyprus
You will be joining a team of 17, working closely with our content and video production team
Compensation: competitive, based on experience and location, plus performance-based bonus

How to Apply
Send us your CV and your LinkedIn profile. Nothing else. No cover letter.
Optional: in three sentences, tell us what you have built with AI and what it did. This is not required - but it is the fastest way to stand out.

In the Global Bank tribe, we're building the infrastructure to provide merchants with a digital business account that empowers them to manage their banking needs. Our goal is to become the most popular banking partner for small merchants globally with an effortless, simple, and affordable experience.
As part of the Bank Activation and Revenue team, you will join a high-impact growth engine within the bank. Our mission is to guide merchants in unlocking the most value out of their SumUp Business Account during their activation journey: we aim to convert 100% of SumUp's ecosystem users into active Bank users.
We own the critical journey from the moment a merchant opens an account until they understand how the business account can solve their business needs, making it part of their daily routine. To achieve this at scale, we are building a greenfield activation and engagement platform consisting of a series of initiatives and experiments to drive adoption and engagement of SumUp users with the business account. Your work will directly drive revenue by enabling seamless cross-selling of the entire SumUp product suite to millions of merchants.
What You'll Do

Build Greenfield Services: Design and implement the trifecta of services (Banners, Rewards, and Feature Toggles) from the ground up to power global product experimentation.
Drive Activation: Create the technical logic that tracks and incentivizes users through their first five meaningful transactions, ensuring a smooth path to becoming a long-term banking partner.
Own the Stack E2E: We follow a "build it, run it, own it" model. You will be responsible for the full lifecycle of your features, from architectural design to production monitoring.
High-Velocity Engineering: Participate in a culture of daily deliveries. We value moving fast, testing hypotheses, and iterating based on real-world data.
Bridge Client & Backend: Build robust APIs that power the mobile and web banking experience while managing complex asynchronous processing for rewards and incentives via Kafka.
Collaborate with Stakeholders: Work closely with other engineering teams across the Bank and the wider SumUp ecosystem to ensure our activation tools are easily integrable and highly scalable.

You'll be great for this role if

Strong technical foundation: Solid backend development experience in Golang, with interest in working across multiple languages (Kotlin, Elixir). You understand system architecture, object-oriented and functional design principles, data modeling, and API design (RESTful and event-driven).
Growth Mindset: You're curious and energized by complex problem-solving. You thrive in environments with fast iterations and careful design, where understanding the problem deeply is valued over rushing to delivery. You're excited by the opportunity to architect critical systems from scratch - like our new global banner service - and work in a team that follows a "build it, run it" model with daily deliveries.
Systems Pragmatist: You understand that supporting and evolving legacy systems is the foundation for future success. You take pride in making existing code better while ensuring new services are architected for the long haul.
Ownership and craft: You take full ownership of the software you ship, from design to production readiness. You value clean, maintainable code and continuously refactor to keep designs simple and scalable.
Communication: You can communicate complex technical trade-offs effectively to your fellow engineers and technical stakeholders.

What You'll Achieve in 6 Months By your sixth month, you will have taken full ownership of one of our Rewards features and contribute to the Banners service. Banners service will be the primary engine for product discovery and cross-selling within the Bank app, enabling our team to run rapid-fire experiments that directly impact SumUp's bottom line.
Any of the following would be considered a plus

Previous experience in a Growth-focused engineering team.
Experience building rules engines or Reward/Incentive systems.
Familiarity with the Fintech or Banking regulatory landscape.

Why you'll enjoy working at SumUp

Be part of a company that values diversity and celebrates unique perspectives.
Work with a global team of skilled professionals in an environment that fosters collaboration, learning, and growth.
Be part of a global tribe building a banking solution from the ground up and delivering impactful solutions to the real-life problems of millions of SumUp merchants all over the world
Career growth and learning opportunities: We invest in your development through regular training, mentorship programs, SumUp University leadership cohort and a yearly learning budget (2,000 EUR)
Sabbatical program for tenured SumUppers
Join a global team where you belong: Check out our D&I Initiatives and Employee Resource Groups such as Pride Club, SumAfro, Neurodiversity, Grupos Mais, Women in Tech, and more
Health & wellness benefits: in-house fitness classes, gym in the office, subsidized Urban Sports Club and available psychotherapy sessions
A lot of other benefits such as Subsidized Public Transport Card, Kita placement assistance, Pension Scheme, Language Learning platform/courses etc.
Enrollment onto our virtual stock ownership program - you will own a stake in SumUp's future success

title: Senior Backend Engineer - Accounts
description_clean:
In the Global Bank tribe, we're building the infrastructure to provide merchants with a digital business account that empowers them to manage their banking needs. Our goal is to become the most popular banking partner for small merchants globally with an effortless, simple, and affordable experience.
You'll help us transition from fragmented regional setups to a unified global infrastructure, directly enabling millions of merchants worldwide to access seamless banking tailored to their needs.
As a Senior Backend Engineer on the Global Accounts team, you'll own critical pieces of our bank account platform. You'll help us design and build a fully distributed, event-driven system designed to scale across regions with resilience and compliance built in.
You'll work primarily in Kotlin, with opportunities in Elixir and Golang. We practice Extreme Programming: small iterations, daily deliveries, and a focus on technical design quality and deep problem understanding.
Our tech stack includes Kotlin, Golang, Elixir, Java, AWS, Kafka, PostgreSQL, and Kubernetes, supported by observability tools like Prometheus, Grafana, and Honeycomb. We also use AI-assisted development tools including Cursor and GitHub Copilot.
What You'll Do

Build critical infrastructure from scratch: Contribute to the design and implementation of a newly architected global accounts platform. You'll help migrate existing systems to a modern, event-driven, decoupled architecture that enables scalability and resilience across regions.
Master event-driven architecture: You'll be working extensively with Kafka to build a truly decoupled, resilient system. Event-driven architecture is essential to our goal of ensuring that failures in one part of the system don't bring down banking operations globally. This isn't just a technical requirement—it's the foundation of building a platform that can handle the complexities of multi-region banking.
Solve complex compliance challenges: Design flexible systems that handle varying regulatory and verification requirements across different regions and use cases. You'll make compliance requirements maintainable and natural rather than an afterthought.
Enable other teams: Build a self-service platform that empowers internal teams across the organization to contribute to and build on top of.
Work globally: Your work will directly impact EU and LATAM markets, with potential US expansion on the horizon.

You'll Be Great for This Role If

Strong technical foundation: Solid backend development experience in Kotlin, with interest in working across multiple languages (Golang, Elixir). You understand system architecture, object-oriented and functional design principles, data modeling, and API design (RESTful and event-driven).
Event-driven architecture expertise: Proven experience with Kafka and event-driven systems. You understand how this enables true decoupling and resilience in distributed systems.
Distributed systems mastery: You've built tested, observable, scalable, robust, and fault-tolerant distributed systems. You have hands-on experience with AWS, Docker, Kubernetes, cloud-native architectures, and relational databases, understanding data consistency and performance considerations.
Ownership and craft: You take full ownership of the software you ship, from design to production readiness. You value clean, maintainable code and continuously refactor to keep designs simple and scalable.
Motivated by the challenge: You're curious and energized by complex problem-solving rather than just shipping features quickly. You thrive in environments with fast iterations and careful design, where understanding the problem deeply is valued over rushing to delivery. You're excited by the opportunity to architect critical systems from scratch and work in a team that practices Extreme Programming with daily deliveries.
Collaborative mindset: You communicate respectfully, share knowledge openly, and actively support your teammates' growth.

title: Customer Support Specialist im Berliner SaaS Startup
description_clean:
Wir sind ein Berliner Start-up mit der Mission, die Arbeitswelt neu zu gestalten.

Mit unserer SaaS-Plattform unterstützen wir Unternehmen dabei, hybride Arbeitsmodelle erfolgreich umzusetzen und Büronutzung und Teamarbeit effizient zu organisieren.
Unsere Lösung hilft Bürokosten zu senken, verbessert die Zusammenarbeit und schafft mehr Transparenz und Flexibilität im Arbeitsalltag.

Qualifikation

Du sprichst fließend Deutsch und Englisch.
Du hast eine positive, lösungsorientierte Einstellung und arbeitest gerne mit Kunden.
Du verfügst über sehr gute Kommunikationsfähigkeiten – schriftlich und mündlich.
Du arbeitest strukturiert, selbstständig und äußerst sorgfältig.
Du bist gut organisiert und behältst auch bei mehreren parallelen Anfragen den Überblick.
Erste Erfahrungen mit HubSpot und Intercom sind von Vorteil.

Benefits

Die Möglichkeit, ein spannendes SaaS-Produkt in einer Wachstumsphase aktiv mitzugestalten – mit viel Raum für Eigenverantwortung und persönliche Weiterentwicklung.
Ein internationales, hochqualifiziertes Team mit flachen Hierarchien, kurzen Entscheidungswegen und einer offenen Unternehmenskultur.
Flexible Arbeitszeiten, die sich gut mit deinem Alltag vereinbaren lassen.
Ein attraktives Büro in der Kastanienallee im Herzen Berlins sowie die Möglichkeit, flexibel remote zu arbeiten.

Wir suchen eine Kollegin oder einen Kollegen, die oder der unsere Begeisterung für innovative Technologieprodukte teilt, die Herausforderungen unserer Kunden wirklich verstehen möchte und neugierig darauf ist, wie sich diese mithilfe moderner Technologien bestmöglich lösen lassen.

Created in Lyon in 2016 by three French entrepreneurs, Agicap is one of the fastest scale-ups in Europe, with over 8000 customers, 650 employees and fast revenue growth (7x between 2021 and 2024). Agicap is part of the French Tech 120, rewarding the most promising startups in France.
 
Agicap allows Finance teams of Mid-Market companies to efficiently manage and forecast their cash, pay their suppliers and get paid. By combining a Treasury Management System, and Accounts Payable and Accounts Receivable solutions into a single platform, Agicap aims at becoming the next leading Treasury Management platform for mid-market companies.
 
We have raised €145M since our creation, with prestigious VC funds including AVP, Greenoaks, Partech and BlackFin, with a last round in November 2024.
 
These additional resources further fuel our product innovation, allowing us to grow significantly and accelerate our international expansion across the world.

Home page
Customer Stories
Our Values

Identifying and targeting SMB companies that could benefit from Agicap’s financial management solutions.
Conducting product demonstrations and presentations to showcase the value of Agicap’s offerings.
Developing and maintaining a robust sales pipeline through prospecting, networking, and referrals.
Building and nurturing relationships with key stakeholders and decision-makers within target organizations.
Negotiating contracts and closing sales to meet or exceed quarterly and annual sales targets.
Staying informed about industry developments, competitor activities, and market trends.
Regularly monitoring and analyzing your performance with Management to identify areas for improvement.
Providing feedback to the Marketing, Business Development, and Product teams to improve processes and the product.
Sharing your commercial expertise and good ideas to enhance the team’s performance.

Native/Bilingual level of German
2-4 years of experience in B2B Sales, preferably in the SaaS industry and with mid-market space, and with some experience working in a finance department/audit/consulting/TS.
Studies background in a top business or Engineering school.
A passion for sales and a proven track record of meeting and exceeding targets.
A tenacious, resilient salesperson who never gives up and is driven by results.

Strong analytical and synthesis skills, excellent verbal communication, and a high level of intellectual curiosity.
Great ambition, with the drive to meet and even exceed objectives.

 7 Reasons to Join Agicap as an AE:
Exceptional product-market fit, confirmed by our latest funding round:
Crucial need → cash = the lifeblood of business, top priority for CFOs (PwC)
Strongly differentiated solution, leader in Europe (G2)

Team of rockstars, friendly and skilled
A growth engine of a large Outbound SDR team, Inbound & Partner leads to help you scale fast!

title: Fullstack Engineer
description_clean:
About Sparkify

Sparkify is built by Onstruc UG, a Berlin-based documentation-software company founded in 2020. Onstruc started out building photo-based documentation tools for the construction trade broadly; about two and a half years ago, the team began focusing that experience specifically on electricians, teaming up with Wiha — a German tool manufacturer with 80 years of history and a genuine fan following in the trade — to build the NFC-enabled hardware integration that's now Sparkify's core differentiator.
Electricians are legally required to document their work — photos, forms, measurement data — after every job; Sparkify replaces pen-and-paper and Excel-and-a-prayer with something that works fully offline in the field, and turns taking a measurement into a tap by pulling data straight off Wiha's testing devices via NFC.
Live for 120 days, we're already at 85+ clients and roughly 125 seats, adding about one new client a day -well financed, growing, and shipping fast with a small senior team. We are looking for someone to take clear ownership of our web platform now: backend, frontend, and the production reality in between.

About the role 

You take operational ownership of our production system: PHP 8 / Symfony services and a Vue 3 web client used by electricians every day. You keep the system stable, keep billing flowing, and work through a concrete, prioritized bug and feature backlog end to end.
This is a full-stack ownership role in the practical sense: no backend feature is done until the UI exists, and no frontend flow is complete unless the API, data model, and operational behavior behind it work properly.
This is not a greenfield fantasy, but it is not a legacy horror either. It is a clear, manageable production system with real users, real revenue, and real momentum. You will not be alone: our infrastructure partner supports the Couchbase layer, and you will work closely with our founder, who's covering CTO duties directly, so the system becomes better documented and easier to own over time.

 
What You'll Do

Own the Symfony service fleet: API, auth, payment, notification, image, and PDF-report services; Symfony Messenger for async jobs
Own the web client with it: a Vue 3 + Vuetify + TypeScript SPA using Pinia and Vite
Ship features end to end across checkout, billing, workspace, admin, and documentation flows
Build data import/export support as new hardware-manufacturer partners join the platform
Keep billing flowing: Mollie subscriptions, webhooks, invoices, SEPA mandates
Run and improve production infrastructure: Hetzner servers, GitHub Actions CI, SSH deploys, Cloudflare DNS, Pulumi IaC, and observability via Sentry, Datadog, and Grafana
Work through a real backlog: well-defined bugs, missing endpoints, data cleanups, hardening items, and pragmatic product improvements
Get productive with Couchbase and Sync Gateway, which power our mobile sync. Prior Couchbase experience is helpful, but not required; our managed-service partner's Couchbase engineers support us here

 
What you bring  

At least 5 years' full-stack engineering experience with strong PHP/Symfony, comfortable owning production systems and being trusted with them
Genuinely comfortable with complex, nested JSON and document-based data modeling — our core datastore is document-based (Couchbase), not purely relational; Couchbase itself isn't required on day one, but this general comfort is
Solid modern frontend skills; our SPA is Vue 3 + Vuetify + TypeScript, and deep Vue experience is ideal
Strong engineers coming from React, Angular, Svelte, or similar frameworks are welcome if they can become productive in Vue quickly
Comfortable with Git submodules and a modular, multi-service repo structure
Excellent English, spoken and written; it is our working language
Good German is a plus
E-commerce or payments experience, for example Mollie, Stripe, or similar, is a big plus
DevOps-capable: comfortable with Linux servers, DNS, CI/CD, and production debugging
Pulumi/IaC experience is a plus
Pragmatic, direct, and able to ship without turning everything into a grand redesign

 
Compensation and Perks

A friendly environment with a small team of collaborative and innovative people.
Competitive salary and compensation package.
Home-office friendly, with an office culture we are actively building and expect people to take part in regularly — this is remote-first, not remote-only: a weekly in-person day and the team's daily video standup are part of the role, not an occasional nice-to-have.
You will work directly with the founder, with fast decisions and very little process theater.

Monitoring-, Logging- und Fehlerbehandlungskonzepte sowie kontinuierliche Optimierung von Performance, Kosten und Datenworkflows.  Data Architecture: Mitarbeit am Aufbau einer skalierbaren Datenarchitektur inklusive Test-, Staging- und Produktionsumgebungen sowie moderner Technologien wie CI/CD, Fabric Pipelines, dbt oder Airflow.  Zusammenarbeit: Enge Abstimmung mit dem Head of Data & und Betrieb von Datenpipelines oder Datenplattformen – idealerweise auf Senior-Level, motivierte Mid-Level-Profile sind ebenfalls willkommen.  Fundierte Kenntnisse in Microsoft Azure Data Services, insbesondere Data Factory und/oder Azure Synapse; idealerweise ergänzt durch Erfahrung mit Microsoft Fabric.  Sehr gute Kenntnisse in SQL und Python, insbesondere im Bereich ETL-/ELT-Prozesse und Automatisierung.  Erfahrung in der Datenmodellierung, idealerweise mit Bronze-, Silver- und Gold-Layer-Architekturen.  Kenntnisse im Datenqualitätsmanagement sowie in Monitoring, Logging und Performance-Optimierung.  Erfahrung in der eigenverantwortlichen Umsetzung technischer Projekte sowie eine strukturierte, lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise.  Ausgeprägte Teamorientierung sowie Freude an der Zusammenarbeit in einem internationalen Umfeld.  Fließende Deutsch- oder Englischkenntnisse. Bei geringeren Deutschkenntnissen (ab B1) werden dafür sehr gute Englischkenntnisse vorausgesetzt.  Nice-to-haves – jedes zusätzliche Know-how ist ein Pluspunkt:Erfahrung mit inkrementellen Ladeprozessen und Delta-Verarbeitung.  Erfahrung in der Datenintegration für Power BI sowie im Umgang mit semantischen Modellen.  Kenntnisse im E-Commerce- oder Amazon-Umfeld.  Erfahrung mit API-basierten Datenintegrationen.  Kenntnisse in CI/CD, z. B. mit GitHub Actions oder Azure DevOps.  Interesse an Machine Learning und dem Aufbau datengetriebener Organisationen.  Erfahrung mit Openbridge. Die Rolle als Data Engineer klingt genau nach dir? title: Senior Site Reliability Engineer (all genders)
description_clean:
Introduction
FACT-Finder entwickelt Product-Discovery-Technologie für den eCommerce und ist mit den Produkten Next Generation und Infinity bei führenden Online-Shops in Europa im Einsatz. Beide Produkte bewegen sich aktuell in Richtung einer modernen, hybriden Plattform auf Basis von Kubernetes und Harvester – mit der Option, mittelfristig vollständig in die Cloud zu skalieren. Als Senior Site Reliability Engineer (SRE) sorgst du dafür, dass unsere Systeme über diese Transformation hinweg schnell, verfügbar und skalierbar bleiben. Du arbeitest mit dem Hosting-Team und erfahrenen Engineers zusammen und gestaltest den Weg zu einer modernen SaaS-Company aktiv mit.
Deine Aufgaben

Du definierst und verantwortest SLOs, SLIs und Error Budgets über beide Produkte hinweg und triffst datenbasierte Entscheidungen zu Reliability und Performance.
Du treibst Incident Response voran: schnelle Detektion, klare Kommunikation, blameless Postmortems und nachhaltige Follow-ups.
Du reduzierst manuelle Arbeit konsequent durch Automatisierung und GitOps (z. B. Argo CD / Flux) und baust self-healing sowie self-service Fähigkeiten aus.
Du unterstützt den Aufbau eines NG Search Operators (Custom Kubernetes Operator / CRDs) und die Einführung von Auto-Scaling (HPA, VPA, KEDA, Cluster Autoscaler).
Du entwickelst unsere Observability weiter – Metrics, Logs, Traces, Alerting und Runbooks, die on-call wirklich helfen.
Du planst Kapazität und Kosten über On-Premise (Frankfurt, Stockholm) und Cloud hinweg – inklusive Burst-Szenarien in die Public Cloud.
Du nutzt AI-Tools, um Diagnose, Alerting und operative Workflows spürbar zu

Dein Profil

Erfahrung als SRE, Infrastructure oder Production Engineer in einem SaaS- oder Plattform-Umfeld – oder ein starker Software-/Operations-Hintergrund mit klarem Willen, in die SRE-Rolle hineinzuwachsen.
Solides Verständnis von SLOs, Error Budgets, Incident Management und Observability.
Hands-on Erfahrung mit Kubernetes und Interesse an Cluster-Lifecycle, Upgrades und Operator-Pattern.
Erfahrung oder starkes Interesse an Harvester bzw. vergleichbaren HCI-/Virtualisierungsplattformen (KubeVirt, vSphere/ESXi, OpenStack).
Vertrautheit mit GitOps (Argo CD / Flux), Container Storage (Longhorn, Ceph) und Kubernetes Networking (Load Balancing, Ingress).
Kenntnisse zu Auto-Scaling-Primitiven (HPA, VPA, Cluster Autoscaler, KEDA) und Kapazitätsplanung on-prem und in der Cloud.
Verständnis für Netzwerke in produktionsnahen Rechenzentren (u. a. VLAN).
Ausgeprägter Automatisierungsinstinkt und eine Haltung, Toil strukturell zu eliminieren.
Praktische Erfahrung im Einsatz von AI-Tools im operativen Betrieb.
Sehr gute Englischkenntnisse; Deutsch von Vorteil.

THE JOY OF WORKING WITH US

Impact from day one: Deine Arbeit wirkt direkt auf die Umsätze führender eCommerce-Marken in Europa.
Moderner Tech-Stack: Kubernetes, Harvester, GitOps, Auto-Scaling und ein spannender Weg in Richtung Cloud – mit Raum, Dinge neu und richtig zu bauen.
AI-first Mindset: Wir nutzen AI nicht als Buzzword, sondern als festen Bestandteil unserer täglichen Arbeit.
Ownership & Wachstum: Klare Verantwortung, kurze Entscheidungswege und die Möglichkeit, deine Rolle aktiv mitzugestalten.
Flexibles Arbeiten: Hybrides Arbeitsmodell mit Fokus auf Ergebnisse.
Starkes Team: Erfahrene Engineers, offene Feedback-Kultur und ein Umfeld, in dem Reliability als Engineering-Disziplin ernst genommen wird.

Standort
Berlin, München, Pforzheim oder Stockholm (Hybrid)

title: Working Student Communication Design (m/f/d)
description_clean:
Hi!
We are Coffee Circle, Germany’s leading sustainable specialty coffee roastery based in Berlin. We offer the world’s finest coffee and equipment to over 150,000 customers online and in our Cafés, driven by our goal to make high-end coffee experiences enjoyable and accessible to all. We foster direct trade relationships with coffee farmers worldwide, pay high prices for the coffee beans, and ensure everyone involved in the value chain gets treated fairly and respectfully. For every kilogram of coffee we sell, we invest € 1 through our Coffee Circle Foundation e.V. to help support sustainable improvements in coffee-growing areas, such as providing clean drinking water, hygiene training, and coffee labs. With over 5 million euros raised in donations, we cannot wait to increase our positive impact with you on our team, one cup of coffee at a time.
Your role

Create engaging marketing materials for offline and online usage, e.g., flyers, Dialogposts, postcards, campaign banners, ensuring they convey Coffee Circle’s key brand messages to our audience
Develop design concepts that relate to our target group and oversee their execution, aligning with key internal stakeholders
Handle in-house production of design items and coordinate external production
Ensure creative alignment with our brand standards across all design elements
Report to our Head of Marketing and Revenue and work closely with our seven-person Marketing Team.

Your profile

Currently enrolled in a design-related university program, such as Communication or Graphic Design, Visual Communication, or a similar field
Proficient in design software, with strong experience in InDesign and knowledge of the Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, etc.) and Figma.
Hands-on experience with communication design and a developed eye for detail
Capable of transforming design requests into performant marketing assets
Creative, organized, and able to work independently as well as collaboratively
Strong attention to detail to ensure designs align with our brand standards
Fluency in English and German (min. C1 level in both languages)
Ability to work on-site at our office in Berlin-Wedding. We expect working students to work at least once a week from our office.

And this is what you will get from us

Flexible working hours. Our core working hours are from 9:30 AM to 3:30 PM, but of course we understand that Working Students have different needs
Discounts on our coffee and accessories, as well as access to online voucher platforms like Corporate Benefits and FutureBens.
Access to platforms for mental and physical health, such as nilohealth, and the possibility to have access to Urban Sports Club M membership after 1 year with us.
The best coffee in the office and quarterly coffee vouchers to enjoy your favorite drink at home with your loved ones.
Regular All-Hands meetings, coffee training, and interdisciplinary team events.
What we believe in

We are a purpose-driven organization. For us, growth means increasing our social impact in coffee cooperatives around the world and opening a new world of coffee to our customers. We strongly believe in authenticity and compassion to build strong and innovative teams. We cultivate a humble and playful mindset to create an endless learning experience for our team.
No matter your ethnicity, skin color, descent, religion, gender, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, or gender identity – if the job description fits you, we can’t wait to meet you.

Your profile

Experience as an SRE, infrastructure, or production engineer in a SaaS or platform environment – or a strong software/operations background with a clear drive to grow into an SRE role.
Solid understanding of SLOs, error budgets, incident management, and observability.
Hands-on experience with Kubernetes and interest in cluster lifecycle, upgrades, and operator patterns.
Experience with or strong interest in Harvester or comparable HCI/virtualization platforms (KubeVirt, vSphere/ESXi, OpenStack).
Familiarity with GitOps (Argo CD / Flux), container storage (Longhorn, Ceph), and Kubernetes networking (load balancing, ingress).
Knowledge of auto-scaling primitives (HPA, VPA, cluster autoscaler, KEDA) and capacity planning on-prem and in the cloud.
Understanding of networking in production-grade datacenters (incl. VLAN).
A strong automation instinct and a mindset to structurally eliminate toil.
Practical experience using AI tools in day-to-day operations.
Fluent English; German is a plus.

THE JOY OF WORKING WITH US

Impact from day one: Your work directly influences the revenue of leading eCommerce brands across Europe.
Modern tech stack: Kubernetes, Harvester, GitOps, auto-scaling, and an exciting path toward the cloud – with room to build things right.
AI-first mindset: We use AI as a real part of our daily work, not as a buzzword.
Ownership & growth: Clear responsibility, short decision paths, and the opportunity to actively shape your role.
Flexible work: Hybrid work model with a focus on outcomes.
Strong team: Experienced engineers, an open feedback culture, and an environment where reliability is treated as a real engineering discipline.

Deine Aufgaben & Verantwortung
As CEO und technischer Kopf gestaltest du die Zukunft von TimberNex an vorderster Front:

Unternehmensführung & Spin-off: Du verantwortest die rechtliche und operative Ausgründung der neuen Gesellschaft und steuerst das Unternehmen als geschäftsführender Gesellschafter.

Finanzverantwortung & Bootstrapping: Du steuerst das Cashflow-Management. Deine Priorität liegt darauf, das Unternehmen schnellstmöglich über eigene Umsätze profitabel zu machen und dein eigenes Zielgehalt aus dem operativen Cashflow zu finanzieren.
Teamaufbau & Skalierung: Sobald die ersten Umsätze fließen, baust du zielgerichtet ein schlagkräftiges Team in den Bereichen Entwicklung, Vertrieb und Operations auf.

Das Finanzierungs- & Beteiligungsmodell
Wir suchen keinen angestellten Manager, sondern einen echten Mitgründer:

Hohe Eigenkapitalbeteiligung (Equity): Du erhältst einen signifikanten Anteil an der neuen Gesellschaft, um am langfristigen Wertzuwachs direkt zu partizipieren.
Revenue-First-Vergütung: Es gibt kein fixes Konzerngehalt ab Tag 1. Dein Gehalt und das Budget für das Unternehmen finanziert sich direkt aus den generierten Umsätzen des operativen Geschäfts.
Commitment (Zeit & Investment): Du bringst die nötige zeitliche Ausdauer sowie die Bereitschaft mit, dich anfänglich finanziell selbst zu tragen (oder durch ein eigenes Start-Investment/Working-Capital die Anlaufphase zu überbrücken), bis die Plattform die ersten stabilen Cashflows generiert.

Unternehmergeist & Hands-on-Mentalität: Du willst bauen, verkaufen und skalieren. Risiko scheust du nicht, sondern siehst darin deine Chance auf maximale Gestaltungsfreiheit.

Finanzielle Belastbarkeit: Du bist in der Lage, eine Anlaufphase ohne festes Konzerngehalt zu überbrücken und dich voll auf das Umsatzwachstum zu fokussieren.

Benefits
Du startest nicht bei null. Als Ausgründung profitiert TimberNex von starken Startbedingungen:

Valider Asset- & IP-Grundstock: Die bestehende Plattform/Technologie, Markenrechte und das bisher entwickelte Know-how gehen in die neue Gesellschaft über.
Netzwerk & Marktzugang: Zugriff auf bestehende Branchenkontakte, erste Testkunden und Branchen-Expertise.
Strategische Begleitung: Unterstützung durch erfahrene Sparringspartner und Beiräte in der Gründungs- und Skalierungsphase, ohne dass dir deine operative Freiheit genommen wird.

Wenn du die Motivation hast, TimberNex als CEO und technischer Mitgründer an die Spitze zu führen und dein eigenes Unternehmen auf einem soliden Fundament aufzubauen, wollen wir dich kennenlernen.
Bitte sende uns deine Kontaktdaten, ein kurzes Profil/CV sowie eine prägnante Nachricht darüber, wie du den Plattform-Rollout und die Erstmonetarisierung angehen würdest.

Du entwickelst modulare und wartbare Backend-Anwendungen, APIs, Datenservices und Integrationskomponenten mit Python.

Fundierte Kenntnisse im Data Engineering und praktische Erfahrung mit Datenpipelines, Datenintegration sowie ETL- oder ELT-Prozessen.
Gute Kenntnisse in Data Science, explorativer Datenanalyse, statistischen Methoden und der Bewertung datengetriebener Modelle.
Projekterfahrung mit Computer Vision, Bildverarbeitung oder vergleichbaren Machine-Learning-Anwendungen.
Erfahrung mit relationalen, nicht relationalen oder Time-Series-Datenbanken und der Verarbeitung strukturierter sowie unstrukturierter Daten.
Erfahrung mit Cloud-Architekturen und Cloud-Services, idealerweise im AWS-Umfeld.
Sicheres Verständnis moderner Softwarearchitektur- und Entwicklungsstandards, beispielsweise Clean Code, Testing, API-Design, Git, Docker und CI/CD.

Eine strukturierte und eigenständige Arbeitsweise, Freude an offenen Problemstellungen sowie gute Kommunikationsfähigkeiten in deutscher und englischer Sprache.

✨ The Principle
Our guiding principle is Do Work You Are Proud Of. We emphasize long-term quality over short-term results. We evaluate our tools and decisions wisely because we want to be proud of what we build together.
Tasks
About The Position
Klar has two big assets outside of our software: the content we produce and the eCom Unity, Germany's largest eCommerce community with 2,500+ active operators. Both are running today — but honestly, neither is running at the level it could. That's where you come in.
You will own our brand end-to-end and build it into a well-oiled machine. Concretely, that means four areas:
1. The Content Engine
We are in the early stages of building a scalable, consistent content operation, and you will play a major role in deciding what it becomes. You will own the overall direction, identify which formats and channels we should double down on, and turn them into a content engine that ships reliably and at a high bar.
Here is what we are currently thinking:

A weekly newsletter that shares the biggest knowledge bombs from our community, workshops, and own research — no fluff, operational insights only.
A podcast and/or YouTube channel where we go deep with the best operators in eCom on how they actually grow their businesses. Not “here is our founding story” — straight to the operational meat.
Personal branding on LinkedIn for our founders and team members. You will build the system, develop the angles, and yes — write in other people’s voices. If ghostwriting feels beneath you, this is not your role.

You will already have a Content & Video Producer on your team, who is also happy to jump in front of the camera and take ownership beyond production. Together, you will orchestrate the content process from idea to distribution. We work AI-first - a well-set-up Claude gets you 90% of a draft; your judgment, taste, and editing get it to 100%.
2. Community & Events
The eCom Unity runs 20+ IRL events per year like our pre-OMR meetup with 150 operators and a bunch of online workshops. Two people on the team run this today, and it's largely on autopilot — your job is to guide them, connect the community to the content engine (every event is content, every discussion is a newsletter), and push the eCom Unity into its next phase as a genuine media asset.
3. Product Marketing
How we talk about Klar — our positioning, our messaging, and our anti-hype stance in a market full of hype — is something you will own and shape. You will be the strategic counterpart to Max, our founder, who is deeply opinionated on this. Your role is to challenge his perspective, sharpen our thinking, and translate a complex product into clear, compelling messaging that makes its value immediately obvious.
4. Website & Sales Collateral
You own our website (Webflow) and the collateral our sales team needs. You should be able to execute most of this yourself — with Figma, Webflow, and AI tools like Claude Code — and pull in engineering or freelancers when needed.
What success looks like after 12 months: a content machine that ships consistently and at high quality, a growing audience (newsletter, community, social) that considers Klar one of the go-to resources for eCom knowledge in Europe — and a measurable content contribution to our pipeline.
Requirements
About You

You are among the best at what you do - we are looking for extraordinarily talented people who are looking to take their career and knowledge to the next level. You likely have 5–10 years of experience across content, brand, or product marketing.
You are smart & naturally curious - existing in-depth knowledge of eCommerce would be ideal, of course, but we understand that this might be a stretch. Thus, you need to be excited to dig into new industries and gain knowledge of the brands, people and operations in it.
You are a great writer and editor - most content starts as words. You write excellent copy in English (German is a plus), and you have the taste to take an AI-generated draft from good to great. You know the difference.
You are a builder, not just a strategist - you don't need a team of ten to ship. You're comfortable in Webflow, Figma, and AI tools, and you'd rather publish this week than perfect a strategy deck.
You lead through others - you'll guide our community team and work with our video editor. You don't need formal authority to get people moving.
You optimize for learning - your main motivation at this point of your career is to learn as much as possible and broaden your tool set. You want to work with people of the same mindset and learn from each other.

About the position 
As a Project Engineering Manager – Core Spreads Manufacturing, you will be responsible for leading, coordinating, and delivering engineering and capital investment projects across the Core Spreads manufacturing network, with a primary focus on the Pratau and Katowice factories. The role is critical to strengthening manufacturing capability by implementing technically robust, safe, compliant, and cost-effective solutions that improve safety, quality, sustainability, reliability, capacity, and overall operational performance. The role covers the full project lifecycle, from initial business needs definition, feasibility assessment, concept development, budgeting, technical design, and supplier selection through installation, commissioning, qualification, operational handover, and post-implementation review. You will ensure that projects are delivered on time, within the approved budget, in accordance with company engineering standards, and in full compliance with safety, quality, food safety, GMP, and regulatory requirements.
You will:

Lead engineering and capital expenditure projects within the Core Spreads factories, ensuring clear scope, objectives, deliverables, responsibilities, timelines, and governance are established from project initiation.
Develop and manage project documentation, including business case inputs, user requirement specifications (URS), scope definitions, technical specifications, cost estimates, project schedules, risk registers, procurement packages, commissioning plans, and handover documentation.
Coordinate engineering design, equipment selection, vendor technical clarification, procurement support, installation planning, construction supervision, commissioning, qualification, and start-up activities.
Monitor project progress, costs, risks, and milestones, escalating issues where required and implementing corrective actions to ensure delivery against agreed targets.
Ensure effective project close-out, including completion of technical documentation, training, asset registration, maintenance requirements, lessons learned, and operational handover to site teams.
Perform engineering assessments, feasibility studies, option evaluations, and technical risk reviews to support investment decisions and project prioritisation.
Analyse process, packaging, utilities, and equipment performance data to identify opportunities to improve reliability, increase efficiency, reduce waste, improve yield, reduce energy consumption, and optimise costs.
Lead or support structured troubleshooting activities for recurring technical issues, applying root cause analysis and practical engineering problem-solving methodologies.
Drive value creation, continuous improvement, and operational excellence initiatives in close collaboration with Manufacturing, Maintenance, Quality, and T&I teams.
Support the standardisation of technical solutions, equipment specifications, and engineering ways of working across the Core Spreads manufacturing network.
Work closely with Manufacturing, Maintenance, Supply Chain, Quality, Safety, Procurement, Finance, and T&I stakeholders to ensure project objectives are aligned with business priorities and site operational needs.
Coordinate external suppliers, contractors, OEMs, and engineering service providers, ensuring clear technical communication, effective scope management, safety compliance, and high delivery performance.
Prepare clear project updates, decision papers, presentations, budget summaries, risk assessments, and steering committee materials for site and regional leadership teams.
Facilitate effective communication between sites, functions, and project teams to enable timely decision-making, resource availability, and smooth project execution during factory operations.
Ensure all project activities comply with company engineering standards, site safety rules, contractor management requirements, food safety standards, quality systems, GMP requirements, and all applicable legal and regulatory requirements.
Lead or support Management of Change (MoC) processes, ensuring that technical, operational, safety, quality, environmental, and financial impacts are appropriately assessed, documented, approved, and implemented.
Promote a strong safety and compliance culture by ensuring that appropriate risk assessments, method statements, permit-to-work procedures, contractor supervision, and safe start-up practices are in place.
Maintain accurate project records and support audit readiness through disciplined documentation, full traceability of decisions, and controlled handover of technical information.

So what does it take to be successful in this role?  
You have a bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Process Engineering, or a related field, along with at least five years of experience in project engineering, process engineering, maintenance engineering, or capital project delivery within the food industry or a similarly regulated manufacturing environment. You bring solid knowledge of food processing, packaging technologies, hygienic design principles, operational excellence, and change management practices. You have a strong understanding of engineering project delivery processes, industrial equipment, utilities, process systems, packaging lines, commissioning, and operational handover. You have demonstrated experience managing project budgets, schedules, suppliers, contractors, risks, and cross-functional stakeholders in a manufacturing environment, and are able to balance strategic project objectives with practical factory execution, ensuring technical solutions are reliable, maintainable, scalable, and aligned with long-term site and category manufacturing strategies. You are fluent in both English and German, with strong analytical and problem-solving skills and a willingness to learn. You are an effective communicator and collaborative team player, open to traveling for project execution, supplier visits, factory acceptance tests (FATs), and on-site activities. Additionally, you are proficient in MS Office and engineering software such as AutoCAD and SolidWorks.

Wir sind vly – ein innovatives FoodTech-Startup aus Berlin, das die Lebensmittelindustrie revolutioniert. Nach jahrelanger Forschung haben wir Produkte entwickelt, die deutlich weniger Zucker und mehr Protein enthalten, mit Preisen ausgezeichnet wurden und deutschlandweit erhältlich sind – wie unsere Milchalternativen aus Erbsenprotein und den allerersten Joghurt aus Ackerbohnenprotein. Du sorgst dafür, dass vly maximale Aufmerksamkeit im Regal bekommt – durch überzeugende Argumente, aufmerksamkeitsstarke Materialien und aktivierende Maßnahmen, die unsere Produkte noch schneller aus dem Regal heraus verkaufen. Du berichtest an unsere Head of Marketing, arbeitest aber auch sehr eng mit Sales, Brand und Design zusammen und bist dabei eine der Schlüsselpersonen, die das große Bild von der Brand bis zur Regalplatzierung versteht.

Du entwickelst starke Trade Marketing Materialien (z.B. Sales Folder, Präsentationen, Wobbler) in enger Zusammenarbeit mit Brand, Design und Sales.
Du organisierst und standardisierst unseren Auftritt bei Trade Messen und Verkostungen in Supermärkten.
Du beobachtest den Wettbewerb sowie die Regalentwicklung und bringst proaktiv Impulse, die unsere Sichtbarkeit und den Impact am POS erhöhen.
Du bist das Verbindungsstück zwischen Marketing, KAM und Field Force mit dem Ziel, effektive Maßnahmen auf Kundenbedürfnisse zuzuschneiden.

Deine Benefits:

Purpose: Es ist absolut essenziell, dass sich das Lebensmittelsystem zum Besseren verändert. Deine Rolle trägt direkt dazu bei, es gesünder und nachhaltiger zu machen.

Echtes Startup Teamgefühl: Ein kreatives und motiviertes Team, das zusammenhält – inklusive regelmäßiger vly-Day- und Offsite-Events.
Teamlunch: Unser Highlight - jeden Tag frisch gekochtes Lunch von unserer eigenen vly-Köchin!

vly-Flatrate: Genieße so viel vly, wie du willst!

Mindset: Du denkst unternehmerisch und packst an – du wartest nicht, bis jemand eine Vorlage für dich erstellt.

title: Talent Acquisition Specialist
description_clean:
Your wellbeing, our mission. Join a company shaping a healthier world.
GET TO KNOW US
At Wellhub we're revolutionizing workplace wellness. Our platform connects employees worldwide to the best partners for fitness, mindfulness, therapy, nutrition, and sleep—all in one simple subscription. Headquartered in NYC with team members in Europe, North America and South America, we're on a mission to make every company a wellness company.We believe work should be fulfilling, inspiring, and balanced. Here, you'll find a team that values wellbeing, collaboration, and different perspectives, where passion and creativity push boundaries to create real impact. Your contributions will help shape a healthier, more balanced world for you and millions of people globally. 
Join us in redefining the future of wellbeing!
THE OPPORTUNITY
We're looking for a passionate and driven Talent Acquisition Specialist to join our People team in Spain! This is a fully remote role, giving you the flexibility to work from anywhere in the country. Please note that candidates must currently reside in Spain.
Join us at an exciting stage of growth at Wellhub, where you'll play a key role in shaping our European expansion. As a Talent Acquisition Specialist, you will partner closely with hiring managers and senior stakeholders to attract, engage, and hire top talent across the region.
In this role, you'll translate business needs into effective hiring strategies, helping to build high-performing teams that drive success in both established and new markets. You'll take ownership of end-to-end recruitment processes, ensuring an outstanding candidate experience while maintaining speed and quality.
Beyond day-to-day hiring, you'll contribute to improving recruiting practices through data-driven insights, helping us scale efficiently as we continue to grow. This is a great opportunity for someone who enjoys a mix of hands-on recruiting and strategic impact, and who is excited to help shape the future of our teams across Europe.
YOUR IMPACT

Manage the full-cycle recruitment process for non-technical roles up to G7 level, ensuring high-quality hires and alignment with business needs.
Partner closely with Hiring Managers and People Business Partners to define hiring strategies, evaluation criteria, and ensure a seamless calibration through kickoff meetings.
Develop and implement innovative sourcing strategies to build diverse talent pipelines and improve overall hiring effectiveness.
Drive a positive candidate experience by maintaining transparent communication, providing timely feedback, and acting as a professional brand ambassador for Wellhub.
Analyze recruitment metrics and data to identify bottlenecks, optimize processes, and formally propose improvements to increase the TA function's efficiency.
Ensure compliance with global labor laws, internal SLAs, and data accuracy (cost centers, candidate stages, and budget alignment) within our ATS (Greenhouse).
Promote diversity, equity, and belonging by proactively sourcing from underrepresented groups and mitigating biases throughout the selection process.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams (People Ops, OD&B) to ensure smooth onboarding and contribute to employer branding initiatives.
Live the mission: inspire and empower others by genuinely caring for your own wellbeing and your colleagues. Bring wellbeing to the forefront of work, and create a supportive environment where everyone feels comfortable taking care of themselves, taking time off, and finding work-life wellness.

WHO YOU ARE

Degree in Business Administration, Human Resources, Psychology, or a related field.
Proven experience in full-cycle recruitment, with a focus on high-demand environments.
Strong analytical skills to track, interpret, and report recruitment metrics.
Demonstrated ability to match financial budgets with candidate expectations regarding salary and benefits.
Experience with Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS), preferably Greenhouse, to manage candidate pipelines.
Solid knowledge of sourcing strategies and tools to attract diverse talent.
Ability to manage multiple priorities and stakeholders in a fast-paced environment.
Proven track record of ensuring a high-quality candidate experience throughout the hiring process.
Fluency in English and German is required. Additional proficiency in either French or Spanish is preferred.

We recognize that individuals approach job applications differently. We strongly encourage all aspiring applicants to go for it, even if they don't match the job description 100%. We welcome your application and will be delighted to explore if you could be a great fit for our team. For this specific role, please note that prior experience in full-cycle recruitment and fluency in English and German are mandatory requirements.
 
FLEXIBLE SCHEDULE:  Flexibility for us isn't just about where we work—it also means being able to shape how and when we get things done. Together with their leaders, employees define schedules that align with their time zones, team needs, and personal routines.
PAID TIME OFF: We know how important it is to take time away from work to recharge. Employees receive a minimum of 25 days paid holiday per year with an additional day for each year of tenure (up to 5) in addition to annual holidays (including an extra holiday on your birthday!).
PARENTAL LEAVE: Welcoming a new child is one of the most special moments in your life. Take the time to be present and enjoy your growing family. We offer 100% paid parental leave to all new parents. Parents giving birth are eligible for an extended leave and a ramp-back period to return part-time while they get settled.  
CAREER GROWTH: Access world-class platforms, participate in interactive sessions,  build your personalized development roadmap, and explore internal opportunities. We focus on continuous learning and feedback to support your journey toward personal and professional success. 
CULTURE: You'll join a team of passionate people who come together to break boundaries, support each other, and create a meaningful impact in workplace wellness. We win together, building trust through open communication and a culture where every perspective matters. Learn more about our shared culture and values here. 
And to get a glimpse of life at Wellhub… Follow us on Instagram @lifeatwellhub and LinkedIn!
Diversity, Equity, and Belonging at Wellhub
We aim to create a collaborative, supportive, and inclusive space where everyone knows they belong. At Wellhub, we welcome and celebrate your authentic self.
Wellhub is committed to creating a diverse work environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, non-disqualifying physical or mental disability, national origin, veteran status, or any other basis covered by appropriate law.
